description: Synthetic benchmark script for the structurally different second game (ADR-0079): the invented Black Water dialogue, upper-left square-cornered box, instant page reveal, one non-Latin line. No real game content.

messages.text: No coin, no crossing. That is the rule and the whole of it.
messages.speaker: ferryman

messages.text: You paid. I did not say the coin was yours.
messages.speaker: ferryman

messages.text: There is a second ferry. There is always a second ferry.
messages.speaker: wren

messages.text: So the story goes. Stories are cheaper than coins.
messages.speaker: wren

messages.text: Вода помнит то, что люди прячут.
messages.speaker: ferryman

messages.text: This is not a toll. This is a habit.
messages.speaker: ferryman
